problem: Suppose $|\,p\,|=\sqrt{3}$ and the angle between vectors $p$ and $q$ is $\theta =\frac{\pi }{6}.$ Find the scalar projection of $p$ onto $q.$
worked_solution:
Using the formula for the scalar projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{q}\,p & =|\,p\,|\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =\sqrt{3}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi }{6}) \\  & =\sqrt{3}\cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \\  & =\frac{3}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
